rules.rule: No hardcoded user-facing UI strings: use String.localized("dotted.key") for Text, Button, Label, navigationTitle, alert, confirmationDialog, accessibilityLabel, and accessibilityHint. CI scripts/check-no-hardcoded-ui-strings.sh and SwiftLint hardcoded_ui_string enforce this. See docs/localization-guardrails.md.

Localizable.xcstrings is upstream-owned by platform-localization. Do not edit in feature PRs. Add English keys as swift.* (or shared unprefixed keys) in platform-localization sources/common/en.json; translations arrive via Crowdin and sync PRs on branch chore/localization-sync-swift (legacy chore/localization-sync-swift-* branches also accepted) authored by app/platform-localization-pr-bot. See docs/localization-guardrails.md.

files.description: Project Swift conventions: access control, async/await, code organization, idioms, formatting.
SwiftUI-specific rules: Dynamic Type, @State privacy, view naming.
Naming Swift entities (types, protocols, functions, parameters, properties, cases) per Apple guidelines and project conventions.
Localization guardrails: upstream-owned catalog, String.localized usage, CI enforcement.
